questions.question: In Terminator 2: Judgment Day, what is the liquid-metal terminator called?
questions.note: Robert Patrick; Arnold’s T-800 is the protector this time.

questions.question: Who played Trinity in The Matrix?
questions.note: Keanu Reeves is Neo; Laurence Fishburne is Morpheus.

questions.question: In Jurassic Park, which dinosaurs hunt the children through the kitchen?
questions.note: The T. rex gets the goat and the Jeep; the raptors get the kitchen.

questions.question: In the Scream films, what is the name of the masked killer?
questions.note: The first Scream landed in 1996; “Do you like scary movies?”

questions.question: Which 1999 found-footage horror film is about three student filmmakers lost in the woods?
questions.note: A marketing legend; it looked like a real missing-persons case.

questions.question: In the 2017 film It, what is the name of the dancing clown?
questions.note: Bill Skarsgård; the Losers’ Club vs. a nightmare in Derry, Maine.

questions.question: In Avatar, what is the name of the moon the Na’vi call home?
questions.note: James Cameron, 2009; unobtanium and a very long runtime.

questions.question: In Black Panther, what is the name of T’Challa’s hidden African nation?
questions.note: 2018 — vibranium, the Heart-Shaped Herb, and “Wakanda forever.”

questions.question: In Denis Villeneuve’s Dune films, what is the name of the desert planet?
questions.note: Also called Dune; the spice is melange. Caladan is the Atreides homeworld.

questions.question: Who directed and starred in A Quiet Place (2018)?
questions.note: Blunt co-stars as his wife; the creatures hunt by sound.
